ticket.title: M4: streaming server, MCP surface and v0.1.0 release
ticket.description: Streaming daemon, MCP tool surface, and the first tagged release. Children added when M3 closes. Ingest must accept one named, band-tagged Beast source per band (1090 on 30005, 978 on 30978) fused into a single tracker, because ADS-R deduplication needs both bands in one table (ADR-0010).

decisions.question: Which egress transport does aerofoil-server expose? Decided by ADR-0006; flip the record to Accepted in the same commit as the decision.
decisions.rationale: SSE provides browser-native EventSource and curl inspectability, WebSocket enables bidirectional client control and telemetry streaming for sdk/AerofoilClient and web-radar, alongside gRPC as the typed protobuf stream.

acceptance_criteria: Children added on milestone entry; ADR-0006 accepted before the server is scaffolded; ingest accepts N band-tagged sources fused into one tracker (ADR-0010); v0.1.0 tagged
